direction: Post-fusion reliability under visual shift, with positive-gain routing and reliability-conditioned abstention
revision55_status: Inspected; all reanalysis exploratory; original protocol/gate preserved unchanged

fresh_dataset.name: RAVDESS speech
fresh_dataset.selection: For each actor, full-AV speech, emotions01,03,04,05,06,07; first4filenames per emotion ranked by SHA256(r56-frozen:+filename)
fresh_dataset.target: six intended acted emotions mapped to CREMA labels
fresh_dataset.roles: all24actors external confirmation; no target fitting/calibration/tuning
fresh_dataset.preaccess: No RAVDESS media/features have been opened for inference in this revision; record metadata only

experts.backbones: Frozen WavLM Base and DINOv2 ViT-B/14
experts.heads: Existing CREMA seed11 audio/interaction/video primary; seed22 audio/interaction/video secondary; no RAVDESS expert training

training.selection: 24 eligible clips per actor ranked SHA256(r56-train:+clip), same selection all conditions
training.no_test_labels: No revision55 test labels used to fit new rules

signals: mean and max adjacent-frame DINO cosine distance
mean and max original-versus90percent-center-crop DINO cosine distance
methods: proposed reliability-conditioned direct gain with training-only support gate
new_hyperparameters: GB100iterations,7leaves,20minleaf,lr.05,l2=1,seed56; Platt logisticC1; same training information for direct and structured comparators
abstention: Only estimated positive gain; reliability support standardized on clean router data; squared standardized distance threshold at95th percentile clean calibration support. Separate source-level Hoeffding region certificate; no OOD guarantee. Support gate is diagnostic not certificate.

primary.comparator: margin gate fixed clean tune threshold
primary.success: 95percent paired actor interval lower>0; secondary difference against same-information direct GB reported; no claim based only on audio gain

secondary: Othermethods/budgets/conditions and seed22; clean CREMA reanalysis exploratory

statistics.batch: re-rank each resampled batch with duplicated actor copies
statistics.MDE: normal approximation from CREMA exploratory paired actor SD before newtest; n24,alpha.05,two-sided,power.8

exclusions: Unreadable/corrupt files reported individually; no accuracy-based exclusion; archive hash failure prevents inference
scope_limits: No new unused CREMA actor pool remains
RAVDESS is domain transfer, not naturally occluded data
All tested policies post-fusion; include expert and selector timings separately
protocol_lock: This design is frozen before RAVDESS inference; fitted artifacts/code hashes added before inference, any deviation explicit
